title: My Home
context: At home you use the same few words every day: rooms, furniture and places. With 'there is', 'there are' and 'in / on / next to' you can describe any home.
contextPersian: در خانه هر روز همین چند کلمه را به کار می‌بری: اتاق‌ها، وسایل و مکان‌ها. با «there is»، «there are» و «in / on / next to» می‌توانی هر خانه‌ای را توصیف کنی.

expressions.persian: من در یک آپارتمان زندگی می‌کنم.
expressions.example: I live in a flat on the third floor.
expressions.examplePersian: من در یک آپارتمان در طبقهٔ سوم زندگی می‌کنم.
expressions.note: BrE: flat. AmE: apartment. Both are fine.

expressions.example: There is a kitchen and there are two bedrooms.
expressions.examplePersian: یک آشپزخانه و دو اتاق خواب هست.
expressions.note: Use there is for one, there are for more than one.

expressions.example: My flat is on the second floor.
expressions.examplePersian: آپارتمان من در طبقهٔ دوم است.

expressions.example: We watch TV in the living room.
expressions.examplePersian: ما در اتاق نشیمن تلویزیون تماشا می‌کنیم.

expressions.example: The sofa is next to the window.
There is some milk in the fridge.
Your keys are on the table.
Where is the remote control? — It's on the sofa.
expressions.examplePersian: کنترل تلویزیون کجاست؟ — روی مبل است.

expressions.example: Is there a washing machine in the flat?

expressions.english: turn on / turn off the light
expressions.example: Please turn off the light when you leave.
expressions.examplePersian: لطفاً وقتی می‌روی چراغ را خاموش کن.

expressions.example: Can you open the window? It's hot.
expressions.examplePersian: می‌شود پنجره را باز کنی؟ هوا گرم است.

expressions.example: It has a small balcony with a nice view.
expressions.examplePersian: یک بالکن کوچک با منظرهٔ قشنگ دارد.

exercises.prompt: There is ___ bed and two chairs in the room.

commonErrors.feedback: With floors we say 'on': on the second floor.
commonErrors.feedbackPersian: با طبقه از on استفاده می‌کنیم.

exercises.explanationPersian: in the fridge یعنی توی یخچال.

exercises.hintPersian: کلمه‌ای چهارحرفی که با n شروع و با t تمام می‌شود.

acceptedAnswers: Is there a washing machine in the flat?
Is there a washing machine in the apartment?
Is there a washing machine in the flat?

commonErrors.feedback: For a question, put 'Is' first: Is there …?
commonErrors.feedbackPersian: در سؤال is اول می‌آید: Is there …؟

exercises.source: من در یک آپارتمان در طبقهٔ سوم زندگی می‌کنم.
acceptedAnswers: I live in a flat on the third floor.
I live in an apartment on the third floor.
I live on the third floor in a flat.
I live in a flat on the 3rd floor.
I live in an apartment on the 3rd floor.

commonErrors.feedbackPersian: برای طبقه از on استفاده می‌کنیم.

exercises.explanationPersian: برای طبقه از on استفاده می‌کنیم: on the third floor (طبقهٔ سوم).

targets: turn on / turn off the light

exercises.prompt: "There are two bedrooms, a small kitchen and a balcony. The living room is next to the kitchen." How many bedrooms are there?

exercises.incorrectSentence: There is two chairs in the kitchen.
acceptedAnswers: There are two chairs in the kitchen.
exercises.explanationPersian: دو صندلی جمع است: there are.

speakingTask.instruction: Describe your home: where it is, how many rooms and what is in the living room.
speakingTask.instructionPersian: خانه‌ات را توصیف کن: کجاست، چند اتاق دارد و در اتاق نشیمن چه چیزی هست.
modelSentences: I live in a flat on the second floor.
There are two bedrooms and a small kitchen.
There is a sofa next to the window.

roleplay.aiRole: A friend visiting your home for the first time
roleplay.objective: Describe your home and answer a visitor's questions
roleplay.context: A friend is visiting your home for the first time. Show them around: say how many rooms there are, where things are, and where the bathroom is. Answer their questions with simple sentences.
roleplay.opening: Wow, nice flat! How many rooms are there?
